title: Podcasts & Audiobooks Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=listen:streak) OR (index=personal sourcetype=antennapod:episode)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="listen:streak","primary",sourcetype="antennapod:episode","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from listen:streak and antennapod:episode to see whether two podcasts feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `listen:streak` and `antennapod:episode` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main podcasts data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
